mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mold_usage_records ( id, mold_id, usage_type, scheduled_start_time, scheduled_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, applicant_id, applicant_name, borrower_name, borrower_company, purpose, status, return_inspection_passed, return_remarks, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{moldId}, #{usageType}, #{scheduledStartTime}, #{scheduledEndTime}, #{actualStartTime}, #{actualEndTime}, #{applicantId}, #{applicantName}, #{borrowerName}, #{borrowerCompany}, #{purpose}, 1, CASE WHEN #{inspectionPassed} IS NULL THEN 0 WHEN #{inspectionPassed} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END, #{returnRemarks}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: update mold_usage_records set status = #{status} where id=#{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(1) FROM mold_usage_records WHERE mold_id = #{moldId} AND status = 2

SELECT id, mold_id AS moldId, usage_type AS usageType, scheduled_start_time AS scheduledStartTime, scheduled_end_time AS scheduledEndTime, actual_start_time AS actualStartTime, actual_end_time AS actualEndTime, applicant_id AS applicantId, borrower_name AS borrowerName, borrower_company AS borrowerCompany, purpose, status, return_inspection_passed AS returnInspectionPassed, return_remarks AS returnRemarks, created_at AS createdAt, updated_at AS updatedAt FROM mold_usage_records WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.sql: SELECT r.id, m.mold_code, m.name AS mold_name, m.category AS mold_category, r.usage_type, r.scheduled_start_time, r.scheduled_end_time, r.actual_start_time, r.actual_end_time, TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.scheduled_start_time, r.scheduled_end_time) AS planned_duration_hours, CASE WHEN r.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND r.actual_end_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.actual_start_time, r.actual_end_time) ELSE NULL END AS actual_duration_hours, CASE WHEN r.actual_start_time IS NOT NULL AND r.scheduled_start_time IS NOT NULL THEN TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, r.scheduled_start_time, r.actual_start_time) ELSE NULL END AS start_time_deviation_hours, r.applicant_name, r.borrower_name, r.borrower_company, r.purpose, r.status, r.return_inspection_passed, r.return_remarks, r.created_at, r.updated_at
mapper.select: FROM mold_usage_records r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id WHERE r.mold_id = #{moldId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
FROM mold_usage_records r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id WHERE r.applicant_id = #{applicantId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
FROM mold_usage_records r LEFT JOIN molds m ON r.mold_id = m.id ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
